content:
Vivian: Quick sync — we need a short 'compliance onboarding playbook' for enterprise buyers asking for BYOK + extended retention. Goal: define minimal launch criteria and a sample evidence export for SOC2/ISO audits. @Ash can you list the concrete evidence items we must produce?

Ash: SOC2/ISO core: system audit logs, admin access logs, configuration change history, key rotation records, BYOK handshake records, and proof of immutable storage for logs. Prefer ndjson exports and detached checksums.

Sam: For BYOK handshake we have a prototype flow: POST /keystore/handshake -> challenge -> customer signs -> POST /keystore/complete. Missing: clear test vectors and signed artifacts in the export. Also missing streaming export implementation for large tenants.

Lia: Customers repeatedly ask for tenant-level retention toggles + legal-hold flag. They want a one-button 'export evidence package' that includes checksums and human-readable manifest.

Vivian: Proposed MVE for launch: 1) Tenant retention toggles (90/365/indef) + legal-hold, 2) BYOK handshake API + rotation logs captured, 3) Streaming audit export (ndjson) with checksum manifest, 4) Ops runbook for assembling evidence package.

Sam: Implementation notes: do streaming export as a background job that writes gzipped ndjson to S3 with a manifest to avoid OOMs. Example config for the job: ``` retention_days: 365 export_format: ndjson compression: gzip include_checksums: true storage_class: standard-ia ```

Ash: Security caveats: redact PII and ephemeral tokens from exports, include redaction audit trail. Also requirement to provide WORM/append-only storage for exported audit logs to satisfy auditors.

Lia: Prioritization context: Customer-A and Customer-B both need sample evidence to sign contracts. If we can deliver sample exports + BYOK artifacts they move forward. Lia: I can get reviewers lined up.

Vivian: Suggested acceptance criteria: - export of 1M events completes < 50m; - manifest + checksum verification included; - BYOK handshake documented and testable; - runbook with step-by-step packaging and contact points.

Sam: Rough estimates: retention toggles + streaming export = 3 sprints; BYOK handshake artifacts + test vectors = 2 sprints; runbook + sample export = 1 sprint.

Ash: Add to acceptance: key custody policy + rotation cadence doc for ISO auditors — rotation artifacts must be present in the evidence package.

Ben: Quick ask — include a simple retention cost estimate per tenant and an ops cost note in the playbook so sales can set expectations.

Vivian: Good call, Ben — I'll add a cost appendix. Next steps: Sam to kick off a small spike for streaming exporter, Ash to draft the evidence spec, Lia to arrange customer reviewers. Sync in 48h. :calendar:

AuditBot: New doc created: /docs/compliance/onboarding-playbook-draft-1767894321 — reviewers: Ash, Vivian

Vivian: Thanks all :thumbsup:
